params.prompt: Stylized blocky Roblox-style cartoon game UI concept art, 16:9 landscape phone game screen, matte flat colors, thick dark outlines, rounded panels, sticker-like cards, chunky bold readable text. Strictly NO neon, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lens flare, NO emissive light, NO glossy shine. Heist-comedy tone, kid-friendly, no blood, no weapons shown. Reward state system: 7 days; claimed days have a green check stamp, today is highlighted with a dark outline and a TODAY pill, locked days have a padlock pill. Includes a close X button top-right, a streak counter, and one big CLAIM button. Title lockup 'GETAWAY ROUTE' like stamped stencil on kraft paper. Scene: a heist planning table, kraft-paper city map with push-pins and hand-drawn kart route between 7 numbered stops, tiny polaroids of rewards pinned at each stop: Day 1 '500 Credits', Day 2 'Spray Tag', Day 3 '1,000 Credits', Day 4 'Kart Decal' TODAY, Day 5 'Charm', Day 6 '2,000 Credits', Day 7 'Static Face Mask' pinned on a tower drawing. Locked stops marked with padlock tape. A cartoon patrol drone toy sits on the map. Clipboard claim card with 'CLAIM' button. '3 DAY STREAK'.
